title: Gujarat Victory Forging IPO
summary: Gujarat Victory Forging IPO is a book-built issue of 1.97 crore shares, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Gujarat Victory Forging IPO has a total issue size of 1,97,00,000 shares and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: Monarch Networth Capital Ltd.,, Nirbhay Capital Services Pvt.Ltd.

Gujarat Victory Forging financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

sections.h: Gujarat Victory Forging IPO Issue Objectives
